children: Brunello Cucinelli offers the most visible growth profile in the luxury sector, Equita SIM's Paola Carboni says. The Italian luxury-fashion company enjoys strong brand momentum and seems to bewell on track to reach its full-year revenue growth target of between 10% and 11%, with visibility rising, the analyst writes in a research note. "The supportive messages provided by the company also contrast with the more cautious tone recently conveyed by other luxury players," she adds. Shares are down 0.4%. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
